decisions.label: Leash bow (m per m)
decisions.note: How high a strained leash's thread bows upward, in metres per metre of its length while slack (it flattens as the leash goes taut). 0.4 as shipped; 0.8 now (Ed, 2026-10-15: "The arc of leashes should be higher").

decisions.label: Leash bow cap (m)
decisions.note: The most a leash's thread bows, in metres, whatever its length. 4 as shipped; 8 now.
